description: What is the generic name of this brand? Returns the active ingredient or ingredients of a US brand-name medicine (e.g. Zocor: simvastatin; Vytorin: ezetimibe and simvastatin), with RxCUI codes, from the U.S. National Library of Medicine RxNorm. Useful for patients, travellers and pharmacy staff looking for the generic equivalent. Brand names must be US ones known to RxNorm; it does not compare prices or say whether a generic is interchangeable for a given patient. (cost: 1 credit)
name: drug_generic_ingredient
